findings.title: Claim form amount differs from total bills
findings.detail: The amount claimed on the claim form does not match the sum of the hospital bill total and pharmacy bills.

findings.title: ICU stay duration in bill differs from clinical record
findings.detail: The hospital bill lists 1 ICU day, whereas the discharge summary narrative states the patient was managed in the ICU and shifted to the ward on day 2 of admission.

quotes.quote: Managed in the ICU with IV fluids, an insulin infusion and electrolyte correction. Shifted to the ward on day 2
